product_version: TigerBeetle current documentation and PostgreSQL 18, checked 2026-10-07
version_sensitive_claims: Q1: TigerBeetle Transfer atomically debits one account and credits one account on the same ledger; PostgreSQL FOR UPDATE locks rows until transaction end and serializable failure requires retrying the complete transaction.
Q2: TigerBeetle Transfer ID is an idempotency key; a retry of a created transfer returns exists and a new transfer returns created.
Q3: TigerBeetle pending transfer reserves pending debit/credit amounts, can be posted, voided or expire, and resolves at most once; partial post releases the remaining reservation.
Q4: TigerBeetle transfers are immutable; correction is a new transfer rather than update/delete.
staleness_risks: Wallet overdraft, availability, retry outcomes and reconciliation policies are product choices; do not treat them as universal TigerBeetle defaults.
The TigerBeetle two-phase transfer term is unrelated to a 2PC protocol with an external PSP.
Author semantic MCQ review and automatic gates only; independent blind review remains TODO.
notes: Standalone case covers internal same-currency transfers and reserve lifecycle absent from Payment System Q5/Q8/Q22.
